items.title: グッチ ビューティ26年クリスマスコフレ、レオナルドモチーフの限定アイテム
items.summary: WWD Japan reports Gucci Beauty's 2026 holiday collection (launching November 4) uses a 'Leonardo motif' drawn from Florentine Renaissance textile patterns, including a cushion foundation (11,110 yen), cheek/eye product (8,580 yen), limited lipstick/gloss items and fragrance gift sets; a standard product-launch trade piece with no reader reaction shown.

items.title: Has Gucci proved Made in China has a long way to go?
items.summary: Jing Daily analysis on Gucci's 'Drip' sneaker, Demna's first shoe for the house and the first Gucci footwear openly labeled Made in China, describes the move as 'dividing the internet' -- some read it as validation of Chinese manufacturing capability, others as a prestige risk -- and situates it within Gucci's broader turnaround under financial pressure.

items.source: Weibo (古驰国内国外价差 FAQ series)
items.title: 古驰国内国外价差还有多少？2026年大降价后已不足10%
items.summary: Weibo consumer-FAQ post states the Gucci China-vs-overseas price gap has shrunk from the historical 30-50% range to under 10% following the 2026 discounting, and notes the broader 'Gucci price cut' topic has drawn over 100 million cumulative social views; no like/comment counts visible on this specific post.

items.source: Sina Sina Weibo entertainment/fashion hourly brief (sina.cn)
items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差有多少？
items.summary: Sina fashion-brief recap of the narrowing Gucci domestic/overseas price gap story, repeating the Ophidia mini bucket (12,300 to 8,700 yuan, about 29% off) and Mercato tote (about 22-27% off) figures first reported in September and noting some discounted SKUs are now sold out at flagship stores.

items.title: 명품 순위 정해준다 인정하면 개추
items.summary: DC Inside luxury-gallery ranking thread places Gucci mid-tier among major luxury houses, with top comments citing its 'youthful' image and bold collaborations as strengths but criticizing recent price/quality inconsistency and the China-made sneaker move as diluting its premium standing versus Chanel, Dior and Hermes.

items.title: グッチは落ち目ですか？
items.summary: Japanese Q&A community thread asks whether Gucci is in decline; the poster (a self-described long-time Gucci small-goods collector) cites recent negative business news as the trigger for asking, and respondents are split between reassurance about the brand's heritage pieces (Horsebit, Bamboo) and agreement that recent collections and pricing have weakened its appeal.

items.title: 140만원짜리 구찌 신발에 붙은 '메이드인 차이나'…'중국산 명품' 통할까
items.summary: Nate News consumer-economy piece on Gucci's China-made 'Drip' sneaker reports the shoe has already been discounted roughly 50% over three months (to about 142,000-160,000 won in some channels) and quotes an industry expert warning that combining origin change with steep discounting risks undermining the brand's luxury positioning and raising authenticity doubts among consumers.

items.title: 在上海一天连关两店，Gucci怎么就"过气"了？
items.summary: Zhihu discussion thread aggregating Xiaohongshu-style consumer sentiment argues Gucci has become 'dated' (过气) in Chinese youth perception, citing commentary that its floral/GG prints feel 'auntie-coded' and overly busy to style, while classic pieces like the Bamboo bag and Horsebit loafer are seen as holding value better than trend-led pieces.
